theme: plate inventory GLOB KEEPKEY MEDIANKV size lens

tests.name: glob_empty_match
tests.cmd: *.plate on log-only dir → empty OK=1 miss soft

weaknesses.title: GLOB returns basenames only not full paths
weaknesses.detail: Agents must JOIN dir+basename for SIZE/READ. Easy to SIZE basename relative to CWD and soft-miss. No GLOB_FULL / absolute path mode.

weaknesses.title: KEEPKEY is substring on key not exact equality
weaknesses.detail: Needle err matches error.plate; peer matches peer_a. Agents wanting exact key must EQS after peel or use LOOKUP. Same class as GREP vs HASLINE.

weaknesses.title: GLOB empty match OK=1 GLOB_N=0 vs missing dir OK=0
weaknesses.detail: No files matching pattern is success-empty; missing directory is fail. Agents checking only OK miss empty inventories.

weaknesses.title: MEDIANKV even count uses lower mid not mean of two
weaknesses.detail: 1,2,8,9 → 2 not 5. Documented in proof but surprises stats agents.

weaknesses.title: No recursive GLOB / ** pattern
weaknesses.detail: Only one directory level basenames. Nested STATE trees need walk glue.

weaknesses.title: KEEPKEY empty needle keeps all without flag
weaknesses.detail: Empty needle is identity keep; easy silent no-op if ARG miss.

workarounds: Always JOIN GLOB dir with basename before SIZE/READ
After KEEPKEY verify exact keys with LOOKUP/EQS
Treat GLOB_N==0 as soft empty even when OK=1
Prefer MEDIANKV for outlier plate sizes vs AVGKV
Require non-empty needle for keep at agent layer
issues_faced: GLOB basename-only forces JOIN dance every measure
